review_method: Final native PNG opened and inspected; all six panels checked.

passes.VI1_7: Distinct numerical, ranking and within-type evidence; no data subset or tail clipping; complete PR endpoints; negative type gains visible.
passes.VV1_5: No text/data occlusion; metric subtitles separated; legends and colorbar clear; all panels contain visible data.

repairs: Shifted type comparison legend from titles.
